desc: the new Echelon Alpha offers a more accessible entry point into the modular Echelon ecosystem. Built around the robust Central Operating Group, a serialized stainless steel chassis, it delivers a rock-solid foundation for a modern defensive handgun. The Variable Interface System enables direct-mount capability for today’s most popular optics, while purpose-driven ergonomics deliver performance where it counts. The Echelon Alpha is ready to perform today and evolve with you over time.
